tiers.tier: Tier 1: 5-Year ILI Pigging Excel + Static SCADA Line-Balance Thresholds
tiers.architecture: 5-year manual MFL pigging spreadsheet comparison + static 5% SCADA volume-balance threshold (blind to <3% pinhole leaks and fooled by thermal linepack swings)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM SCADA Alarm & Drilling Mud-Log Summarizer
tiers.architecture: Feeding SCADA pressure logs and daily drilling reports into GPT-4o / Claude to recommend pipeline valve shut-ins and mud weight adjustments without transient hydraulics

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Standalone Acoustic/Flow ML Without RTTM Linepack or ASME B31G Physics
tiers.architecture: Pure ML classifier on flowmeters without Real-Time Transient Model (RTTM) compressible linepack compensation, ILI odometer dynamic time warping, or B31G burst physics

tiers.tier: Tier 4: API 1130 RTTM + Negative-Pressure-Wave ToF + DTW ILI-B31G Corrosion Gate + Torque-Drag Stuck-Pipe Agent
tiers.architecture: Compressible RTTM Mass-Momentum Balance + Acoustic Negative-Pressure-Wave (NPW) Time-of-Flight + DTW-Aligned ILI Pit-Growth + ASME B31G / API 579 FFS + Real-Time Torque-Drag Agent

scenarios.scenario: Pump-Startup Linepack Transient vs. True 0.8% Pinhole Leak at KP-142.6
scenarios.question: Distinguish a legitimate pump-station startup pressure wave (which causes temporary inlet>outlet volume imbalance) from a 0.8% pinhole rupture at Kilometer Post 142.6
scenarios.model_answer: Solve API 1130 Real-Time Transient Model (RTTM) continuity & momentum PDEs for linepack inventory dM/dt + cross-correlate Negative Pressure Wave (NPW) acoustic time-of-flight (pinpoints KP-142.6 +/- 45m in 1.8 min)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 static balance misses the 0.8% leak for 3 hours; Tier 3 uncompensated ML triggers a false pipeline shut-in on normal pump startup ($185K downtime).

scenarios.scenario: Multi-Run Inline Inspection (ILI) Smart-Pig Odometer Drift & ASME B31G Burst-Pressure Gate
scenarios.question: Align 2022 and 2026 Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) smart-pig runs across 32,000 girth welds to compute pit-corrosion growth rate and schedule integrity digs
scenarios.model_answer: Align girth-weld signatures via Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) (+/-2cm accuracy), compute Bayesian pit-depth growth (da/dt = 0.42 mm/yr), and evaluate Modified ASME B31G Folias factor M -> schedule dig only when Safe Working Pressure < 1.25x MAOP
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 linear odometer offset misaligns pits by 4.5 meters (digging up healthy pipe at $45K/dig, 38% overkill) while missing an interacting pit cluster.

scenarios.scenario: Directional Drilling Pack-Off & Differential Stuck-Pipe Early Warning (15 Minutes Pre-Stuck)
scenarios.question: While sliding at 4,200m Measured Depth, standpipe pressure creeps up +180 psi while pick-up hookload diverges from soft-string Torque & Drag model and shakers show cavings
scenarios.model_answer: Detect friction-factor multiplier divergence (>0.38) + annular ECD cuttings-loading rise; halt ROP, reciprocate string, and sweep high-viscosity pill 15 minutes before pipe packs off
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1/2 waits until drillstring torque stalls completely, causing a 64-hour stuck-pipe fishing/sidetrack Non-Productive Time (NPT) event ($1.9M rig loss).

scenarios.scenario: Depleted-Zone Lost Circulation vs. Wellbore Kick Pore-Pressure Fracture-Gradient Window
scenarios.question: Mud pit volume drops -12 bbl in 8 minutes while drilling into a fractured carbonate zone; adjust Managed Pressure Drilling (MPD) choke without inducing a gas kick
scenarios.model_answer: Bound MPD backpressure strictly inside deterministic Pore-Pressure to Fracture-Gradient (PP-FG) window: reduce ECD below fracture gradient while keeping BHP >= Pore Pressure + 150 psi trip margin
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 LLM suggests dropping mud weight below pore pressure to stop losses, risking an underbalanced gas kick.

key_findings: Tier 4 (API 1130 Compressible RTTM + Negative-Pressure-Wave Acoustic ToF + DTW-Aligned ASME B31G + Torque-Drag Agent) detects 0.8% pinhole pipeline leaks in 1.8 minutes (down from 180 minutes) while cutting false emergency shut-ins from 19.5% to 0.3%.

Aligning multi-year MFL smart-pig runs via Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) on girth-weld signatures and gating excavations on Modified ASME B31G burst pressure slashes unnecessary $45K integrity digs from 38.0% to 1.4%.

Coupling real-time soft-string Torque & Drag friction residuals with Managed Pressure Drilling (MPD) Pore-Pressure/Fracture-Gradient bounds cuts stuck-pipe Non-Productive Time (NPT) from 64.0 to 3.5 hours/month, reducing monthly shut-in, dig, and NPT losses from $980K to $96K (-90.2%).
